parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert handling rule.
You can call [DescribeImageEventOperationPage](~~DescribeImageEventOperationPage~~) to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
告警处置规则ID。
您可调用[DescribeImageEventOperationPage](~~DescribeImageEventOperationPage~~)获取该参数
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The rule scope. The value is in JSON format. The following keys are supported:
type: the scope type.
value: the scope value.
This parameter and Source cannot both be empty. If Source is set to agentless, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
规则范围。JSON格式，key取值：
type：范围类型。
value：范围值。
该参数不能和Source同时为空，若Source为agentless时，该参数无效
parameters.name: scenarios

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist source. Valid values:
image: image.
agentless: agentless detection.
This parameter and Scenarios cannot both be empty. If this parameter is set to agentless, the Scenarios parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
白名单来源。取值：
image：镜像。
agentless：无代理检测。
该参数不能和Scenarios同时为空。若该参数为agentless时，Scenarios参数无效
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The rule conditions. The value is in JSON format. The following keys are supported:
condition: the matching condition.
type: the matching type.
value: the matching value
parameters.help_zh:
规则条件。JSON格式，key取值：
condition：匹配条件。
type：匹配类型。
value：匹配值
parameters.name: conditions

Code.description_en: The status code returned by the API request
Code.description_zh: 接口请求返回的状态码

Id.description_en: The ID of the alert handling rule, which is the same as the alert handling rule ID in the request parameters
Id.description_zh: 告警处置规则ID，和入参的告警处置ID相同

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

Success.description_en:
The status of the request response. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求响应结果状态。取值：

true：处理成功。
false：处理失败
